items.title: 10.11 Electrode potentials (oxidation aur reduction ki aasani) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.11, printed pages 224-225.

blocks.text: Redox processes mein do aisi species ke darmiyan redox equilibrium hota hai jo kimiyai taur par juri hon magar mukhtalif oxidation states mein hon. Jab kisi metal ko us ke apne ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to metal aur solution ke metal ions ke darmiyan ek electric potential (voltage) ban jata hai. Ise electrode potential kehte hain; yeh batata hai ke substance kitni aasani se oxidize ya reduce hota hai. Misal: copper ki rod ko us ke ions ke aqueous solution mein rakhein to yeh equilibrium qaim hota hai:
Is equilibrium mein do mukhalif (opposing) reactions chal rahe hote hain:
a) Rod ke metal atoms ions ban kar solution mein jate hain aur electrons electrode ki satah par chhor jate hain.
b) Solution ke ions rod se electrons le kar electrode ki satah par metal atoms ki shakal mein jam jate hain.
Redox equilibrium us waqt qaim hota hai jab electrons lene ki rate electrons khone ki rate ke barabar ho jaye.
Copper jaise kam reactive (unreactive) metals mein, doosre metals ke muqable, equilibrium zyada daen (right) taraf hota hai:
Is liye Cu²⁺(aq) ions nisbatan aasani se reduce hote hain; woh aasani se electrons le kar copper metal ban jate hain.
Vanadium jaise reactive metals mein equilibrium zyada baen (left) taraf hota hai:
Is liye V²⁺(aq) ions mushkil se reduce hote hain; woh muqablatan bohat kam electrons lete hain. Apne ions ke solutions mein rakhe mukhtalif metals ke liye equilibrium ki position mukhtalif hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Reactive metal ki rod par electrons zyada kyun jama hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Reactive metal ke atoms aasani se ions ban kar solution mein chale jate hain (equilibrium baen taraf), aur apne electrons rod par chhor jate hain. Is liye rod solution ke muqable zyada negative ho jati hai, aur us ka electrode potential zyada negative hota hai.

items: Electrode potential: metal aur us ke ions ke solution ke darmiyan voltage; oxidation ya reduction ki aasani batata hai.
Equilibrium Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu: electron lene aur dene ki rate barabar.
Copper: equilibrium daen, Cu²⁺ aasani se reduce. Vanadium: baen, V²⁺ mushkil se reduce.
